Tours.title: Tours & Walks in São Vicente
Tours.description: Guided hikes, day trips and city walks with local operators.

booking.title: Book this tour
booking.description: Contact the operator directly on WhatsApp to reserve your spot.
booking.message: Hello! I would like to book the tour {tour}. Date: … Number of people: …

knowBeforeYouGo.comfortableInWater: Participants should be comfortable in the water
knowBeforeYouGo.respectMarineLife: Respect for marine life and the environment is mandatory

monte-verde-hike.name: Monte Verde Sunrise Hike
monte-verde-hike.description: Climb the highest peak of São Vicente with a local guide and enjoy wide views over the island and the nearby coast.

views.title: Summit Views
views.description: Look out over Mindelo, the bay and the neighbouring islands.

guide.title: Local Guide
guide.description: Learn about the island's plants, history and stories on the way.

santo-antao-day-trip.name: Santo Antão Day Trip
santo-antao-day-trip.description: Take the ferry to Santo Antão for a full day of green valleys, mountain roads and local food.

ferry.title: Ferry Crossing
ferry.description: A scenic crossing between the two islands.

valleys.title: Green Valleys
valleys.description: Drive through dramatic mountain landscapes and farming villages.

mindelo-city-walk.name: Mindelo City Walk
mindelo-city-walk.description: A relaxed walk through the colonial centre of Mindelo, its markets, squares and music landmarks.

history.title: Colonial Centre
history.description: Discover the old streets, the market and the waterfront.

music.title: Music Stories
music.description: Visit places linked to morna and the island's famous musicians.

sea-turtles-sao-pedro.name: Swim with Sea Turtles in São Pedro
sea-turtles-sao-pedro.description: Snorkel with sea turtles in the fishing village of São Pedro. A local team gives a short briefing, then takes you to clear water where turtles swim freely, keeping the experience safe and respectful of the animals.

snorkel.title: Snorkel with Turtles
snorkel.description: Swim alongside turtles in clear, calm water.

marineLife.title: Marine Life Up Close
marineLife.description: See fish and the seabed in their natural setting.

pickup.title: Pickup in Mindelo
pickup.text: Meet your driver at the agreed pickup point.

snorkel.title: Snorkeling with turtles
snorkel.text: Briefing, boat ride and guided snorkeling.

swimmer.question: Do I need to be a strong swimmer?
swimmer.answer: No, but you should be comfortable in the water. Masks and vests are provided.

children.question: Is it suitable for children?
children.answer: Ask the operator on WhatsApp about age limits.

weather.question: What if the weather is bad?
weather.answer: The operator will contact you to reschedule.

videos.question: Will I get photos or videos?
videos.answer: Yes, the team takes them and shares them with you.
